'Giant Ojousama' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, Teaser Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Q Nikumura's Giant Ojousama manga revealed the main cast, additional staff members, and a teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027. Voice actors Yuu Serizawa (Otaku ni Yasashii Gal wa Inai!?) and Junya Enoki (Jujutsu Kaisen) are starring as Oriko Fujidou and Dr. Sebastian, respectively. 'Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lily Part 2' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Songs
The official website of the Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly (Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly) original television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, theme songs, and the main visual (pictured) for its second part on Thursday. The second part is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 10.30 p.m. Tokyo MX, followed by broadcasts on ABC TV, TV Aichi, BS Nippon Television, and AT-X. 'Dragon Ball Super: Beerus' Reveals Main Staff, Theme Songs, "Super Surge" Promo
The official website of the Dragon Ball franchise revealed the main staff, theme songs, "Super Surge" visual (pictured), and promotional video for its new television anime on Thursday. Produced by Toei Animation, the new anime series Dragon Ball Super: Beerus, featuring new cuts, redrawn scenes, and a complete reconstruction of the Dragon Ball Super story, will premiere on October 11 at 11.15 p.m. on Fuji TV's nationwide network. 'Nippon Sangoku' Anime Sequel Announced
Production company Twin Engine announced on Thursday that a sequel to the Nippon Sangoku (Nippon Sangoku: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun) television anime is in production. Produced by Studio Kafka, the anime series adapting Ikka Matsuki's post-apocalyptic drama manga began airing on April 7. TV Anime 'Kin to Tetsu' Announces Lead Staff
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ayaka Katayama's Kin to Tetsu (Fungus and Iron) manga revealed the lead staff and a second teaser visual (pictured) on Tuesday. Keitarou Motonaga (Hametsu no Oukoku, Saikyou no Ousama, Nidome no Jinsei wa Nani wo Suru?) is directing the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab.
